claim_status_semantics: claim_status uses the canonical Claim Schema v1.0 statuses: EXPLICIT | INFERRED | UNKNOWN. EXPLICIT = source-stated semantics; INFERRED = project/AI interpretation or project transfer hypothesis; UNKNOWN = source provides no defining semantics (NOT_PINNED). The 6-class semantic_classification (EXPLICITLY_PINNED / SOURCE_PERMITTED_MULTIPLE_VARIANTS / PARTIALLY_PINNED / NOT_PINNED / REQUIRES_UNAVAILABLE_INPUT / INFERRED_PROJECT_TRANSFER) is a separate research-classification layer.
